text.text_excerpt: 3rd trip to NOLA, decided to stay at new hotel. Both other trips i stayed at the same hotel each trip. This was close to Harrahs casino, that part of town. Its walking distance to alot of stuff, french quarter isnt too far. The room was nice. I think they upgraded me to a king suite, so that was nice. I was here superbowl weekend, so it was packed naturally. And mardi gras had just started. Hotel staff was super friendly as always, room was a good size. Clean and up to date. Not sure if there is a pool/jacuzzi. Weather was not up to par so didnt even bother checking. Not a bad stay, id come again!

Stayed here last weekend and it was great. The room had a fantastic view of the City, and our floor was very quiet. The staff was nice, and the valet worked really well. It was an easy walk to the Dome, the Quarter, or the Warehouse District. It's right around the corner from Manning's, which I would not recommend for cheap drinks. The only bad thing my wife and I thought was we wish we'd have brought our swimming stuff because they have a salt water lap pool. The workout area is great too.

It's a rarity whenever I get to stay in a hotel in New Orleans, but when I do it's a real treat. Somehow my expectations were super low at Loews but the moment I was on the property, they exceeded all of them almost instantly. The stay was so good that I'd consider Loews each and every time. In the hospitality biz, service is everything. From the kind folks at the front desk to the cleaning ladies, everyone was incredibly professional and kind. Being that we are in the South, I generally expect a staff to have good manners, but they were beyond polite.
